Compatibility wrappers for fuzzing Solana execution, decoding inputs and encoding results.

# Purpose
This file provides the `sol_compat` interface for Solana compatibility tests and execution wrappers. It creates and manages a shared `fd_solfuzz_runner_t` instance, sets up a workspace, and optionally enables `solcap` logging through the `FD_SOLCAP` environment variable. The `sol_compat_init()` and `sol_compat_fini()` functions handle process setup and shutdown, while `sol_compat_get_features_v1()` builds the feature list that the compatibility layer reports to callers.

The rest of the file defines a set of entry points that decode protobuf input, run a specific fuzz or execution path, and encode the result back to protobuf output. These functions cover instruction execution, transaction execution, block execution, ELF loading, VM syscall execution, VM interpretation, shred parsing, and type execution. Each wrapper uses the shared runner, manages scratchpad state with `fd_spad_push()` and `fd_spad_pop()`, and releases decoded protobuf memory before return.
